method: Special-wine and current Wine of Origin research pass. Legal/product facts are source-backed; historical applicability remains separately versioned.

profiles.name: Jerez-Xérès-Sherry — detailed product matrix

productionRules.dryVinification: complete alcoholic fermentation for base wine used for generosos
productionRules.sweetVinification: must or fermenting must fortified to prevent or stop fermentation
productionRules.asoleo: traditional optional pre-vinification sun-drying especially associated with sweet wines

ageingMechanisms.Amontillado: biological phase followed by oxidative phase
ageingMechanisms.Palo Cortado: predominantly oxidative after disappearance of initial flor
ageingMechanisms.Oloroso: exclusively oxidative after disappearance of initial flor

geography.jerezSuperior: separate council list of vineyards considered capable of superior-quality grapes on agrogeological and climatic grounds

styleNotes: The consolidated specification defines sensory requirements by product, including biological-ageing aromas for Fino and oxidative/nut/wood characters for oxidative categories.
Qualified-age generosos may reach up to 9 g/L sugar under the specification's acidity condition; this exception must not be applied to ordinary dry generosos.
researchNotes: The 2025 Consejo annual report lists seven authorized white varieties; Beba, Perruno and Vigiriega were added in 2022 and remain minor.
Manzanilla-Sanlúcar de Barrameda is a separate DOP and must not be flattened into Jerez-Xérès-Sherry even though the systems are closely related.

profiles.name: Porto / Port — special-category matrix

LBV.bottlingDeadline: 31 December of the sixth year after harvest

Vintage.bottlingDeadline: 30 July of the third year after harvest

researchNotes: This matrix promotes category, ageing, bottling and service facts but intentionally remains reference-only until the complete current grape, benefício and fortification/certification rule set is extracted.
Age indication is a sensory/age-profile designation of a multi-year wood-aged blend, not a literal arithmetic age of every component.

profiles.name: Tokaj PDO — specialty-wine product matrix

drySzamorodni.process: bunches containing both aszú and healthy berries are processed together

sweetSzamorodni.process: bunches containing both aszú and healthy berries are processed together

Aszu.berries: Botrytis-affected shrivelled berries individually selected by hand
Aszu.macerationBase: must, partially fermented must, fermenting must or wine of the same vintage
Aszu.earliestRelease: 1 January of the third year after harvest

Eszencia.process: free-run juice exuded under the berries' own weight, without pressing, followed by minimal fermentation

Forditas.process: pressed aszú dough is refilled with must, partially fermented must, fermenting must or wine of the same vintage

Maslas.process: lees of Aszú or Szamorodni are topped with must, partially fermented must or fermenting new wine

productionRules.protectedOriginBottling: Tokaj PDO wines bottled within the delimited product-specification area

researchNotes: Current Aszú rules use a 120 g/L minimum residual sugar; the optional expression 6 puttonyos requires at least 150 g/L.
Historical puttonyos systems and pre-2020 product-law versions must remain separately versioned rather than projected from these current rules.

profiles.name: South African Wine of Origin — current production-area framework

productionRules.authority: SAWIS administers the Wine of Origin system
productionRules.currentProductionAreaSource: June 2024 official production-area table, cross-checked against current SAWIS production-area page

researchNotes: The current SAWIS site remains the authority for production areas and maps. The June 2024 table contains a materially expanded hierarchy compared with the old 2009 WO booklet.
SAWIS publishes annual vine-age, cultivar-by-region, irrigation and trellising datasets; those are time-stamped statistical layers and must not be confused with WO legal identity.
Full current production-area identity ingestion is a separate structured registry pass so wards and districts remain individually addressable.
